title: NVIDIA Run:ai Is Now Open Source as Part of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform
text:

NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to production-grade AI workload and GPU orchestration capabilities. This release expands the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform by establishing NVIDIA Run:ai as an open foundation that enables the broader ecosystem to bring differentiated solutions to market…
